title: Strings that contain line breaks
notes: Whatever style the writer picks (literal block, folded block or a quoted scalar with escapes), the line breaks, the trailing breaks and the leading spaces come back exactly. A literal block whose first lines hold only spaces needs an indentation indicator when those lines are longer than the first text line (YAML 1.2.2 section 8.1.1.1); without one the text is not valid YAML.
